entities.name: Query flavohemoprotein
observations: 393 aa; estimated molecular weight 43.16 kDa and theoretical pI 5.99.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial flavohemoproteins, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa Q9I0H4 at 73.5% identity over 99.7% coverage.
Pfam architecture: N-terminal Globin domain PF00042 at residues 27–131; FAD_binding_6 PF00970 at 159–253; NAD_binding_1 PF00175 at 264–366.
Homolog annotations support one heme b and one FAD per subunit.
Likely nitric oxide dioxygenase involved in aerobic NO detoxification and nitrosative-stress response; exact activity is inferred from close homologs, not directly assayed for this sequence.
Candidate reactions use NADH or NADPH to convert nitric oxide and oxygen to nitrate.
Homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic; no signal peptide or transmembrane segment is evident from the reported architecture.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, homology, domains, cofactors, reactions, localization and GO evidence

entities.name: Q9I0H4
observations: Reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa flavohemoprotein with 73.5% identity and 99.7% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated as nitric oxide dioxygenase EC 1.14.12.17, binding heme b and FAD, and functioning in cytoplasmic NO detoxification.

entities.name: Flavohemoglobin NO dioxygenation
observations: Candidate reaction: 2 nitric oxide + NADPH + 2 O2 → 2 nitrate + NADP(+) + H(+), Rhea RHEA:19465.
Alternative candidate reaction uses NADH instead of NADPH, Rhea RHEA:19469.

source_tools.relevance: Reaction candidates from annotated flavohemoprotein homologs

entities.name: Nitrosative stress response
observations: Close reviewed homologs associate the protein with cellular response to nitrosative stress and nitric oxide catabolism.

source_tools.relevance: GO biological-process annotations of close homologs
